title: Generic embedding of an ideal multiple into an ideal sum
statement: Let $X$ be locally Noetherian and quasi-compact [pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $i:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion with $Z$ integral [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-pc-integral-scheme], and let $\xi\in X$ satisfy $\overline{\{\xi\}}=i(Z)$. Let $G$ be a coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] whose nonzero-stalk locus is $i(Z)$ and whose $\xi$-stalk is annihilated by the maximal ideal of $\mathcal O_{X,\xi}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk, def-weil-residue-field]. For each quasi-coherent ideal $I$ of $\mathcal O_Z$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], there is $r\ge1$ such that, writing $M=(i_*I)^{\oplus r}$ for the specified categorical biproduct, either $M$ is a zero object, or there is a quasi-coherent ideal inclusion $\iota:J\hookrightarrow\mathcal O_X$ surjective at the $\xi$-stalk, and a monomorphism $\tau:JG\hookrightarrow M$ [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk] whose map on $\xi$-stalks is bijective. No property $P$ of modules, choice of a $P$-subobject, or short exact sequence occurs in this assertion.

proof.text: The closed immersion is finite, and Z is locally Noetherian. Ideals on Z are quasi-coherent submodules of its coherent structure sheaf and hence coherent. Their finite closed pushforwards and finite sums are coherent. If I is the zero ideal, its pushforward is zero, so r=1 gives the first alternative.

Assume I is nonzero. The image of the generic point of the integral scheme Z is ξ: its closure is the closed image, as is the closure of ξ, and generic points in the sober scheme X are unique. Apply the generic-point ideal inclusion to G. It gives an ideal A and a monomorphism from the pushforward of its rank-r sum into G, an isomorphism near ξ. As G has the whole closed image as support, its ξ-stalk is nonzero. Thus r≥1 and A is nonzero.

Put B=I∩A. On a nonempty affine open both ideals have nonzero sections. The affine ring is a domain, so the product of two such sections is nonzero and belongs to B. Hence B is nonzero. Its inclusions into I and A are bijective on generic stalks, since each nonzero ideal of the generic field equals that field. Their pushforward rank-r sums have a common coherent module K, with monomorphisms β:K→G and γ:K→M. Both are bijective at ξ. Closed pushforward commutes with finite sums because it is additive and preserves finite products; stalk naturality identifies the generic maps.

Let Q=coker β. Coherent cokernel closure makes Q coherent. Stalk exactness and the generic bijectivity of β show Qξ=0. Its support is closed; therefore Q vanishes on an open neighborhood of ξ. The quasi-coherent annihilator ideal J supplied by scheme-theoretic support annihilates Q and is the whole structure sheaf on this neighborhood. Its inclusion ι:J→OX is consequently surjective at ξ.

Multiplication J⊗G→G followed by G→Q is zero because J annihilates Q. Hence its image JG maps to the kernel of G→Q, which is K via β. Denote this factor by t:JG→K and put τ=t followed by γ. Since βt is the canonical mono JG→G, t and τ are monomorphisms. The ideal-product stalk formula and surjectivity of Jξ→OX,ξ show (JG)ξ→Gξ is bijective. Since βξ and γξ are also bijective, τξ is bijective. This gives the second alternative.

theorem coherent_ideal_patching_generic_embedding
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [CompactSpace X]
    (Z : Scheme.{u}) (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsIntegral Z]
    (ξ : X) (hclosure : closure ({ξ} : Set X) = Set.range i.base)
    (G : X.Modules) (hG : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace G)
    (hsupport : {x : X | ¬ Subsingleton (G.presheaf.stalk x)} = Set.range i.base)
    (hkill : ∀ g : X.presheaf.stalk ξ,
      ∀ m : (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace ξ).obj G,
        g ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal _ → g • m = 0)
    (I : Z.IdealSheafData) :
    ∃ (r : ℕ), 1 ≤ r ∧
      let M := @biproduct (Fin r) X.Modules _ _
        (fun _ : Fin r ↦ (pushforward i).obj I.toModules)
        (HasBiproduct.of_hasProduct (fun _ : Fin r ↦ (pushforward i).obj I.toModules))
      (IsZero M ∨
        ∃ (J : X.Modules) (ι : J ⟶ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf),
          Mono ι ∧ J.IsQuasicoherent ∧
          Function.Surjective
            ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace ξ).map ι).hom ∧
          ∃ (τ : idealModuleProduct ι G ⟶ M), Mono τ ∧
            Function.Bijective
              ((RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor X.toRingedSpace ξ).map τ).hom)
